- Source retrieval: 9/10 URLs fetch-verified; all 10 resolved, including the documented failed SciSpace URL.

The full-run checks remain blocked outside this pair: the dependency gate reports 17 global errors, and the cross-batch collector stops on Batch 37’s malformed `justified_by` field. Autopilot still reports Batch 19 missing and a plan JSON parse error at position 6647, line 129, column 2. I did not edit shared plan or engine state.
